thread:
tess: Quick ask for April 14 launch + webinar inbound pack. Need a compact benchmark hero, a 2-slide SVG funnel (reg -> qualify -> demo), 3 social card templates (IG, LI, X) with accessible color variants, an email badge, and a mobile thumbnail. Deadline: first comps tomorrow noon PT.

miguel: Can do. Quick Q: hero size preference? OG 1200x630 or wide 1600x900? And should benchmark plot be tokens/sec vs cost_per_1000 or cost vs p95?

tess: Use 1600x900. Plot cost_per_1000 (x) vs p95_ms (y). Show trend line and two callouts: "lower-cost" and "lower-latency" (non-numeric).

zoe: Brand constraints: use type-spec-v3, neutral canvas (no purple gradient), add footer lockup: "Redwood Inference 30 production-ready inference" and source note: "internal benchmark; illustrative". Provide alt-text for each asset.

marie: Localization: APAC short-CTA variants and dark-mode palette for socials. Animated sparkline: subtle 10-frame loop, keep GIF <1.8MB for IG. Provide MP4 fallback for LinkedIn.

miguel: Deliverables I'll export: hero_bench_1600x900_svg/png/jpg, hero_og_1200x630.jpg, funnel_slide1.svg/png, funnel_slide2.svg/png, social_ig_1080x1080_static+gif, social_li_1200x627_mp4+static, social_x_800x450_static+gif, landing_thumb_600x800_copyfirst.png, email_badge_round+pill_3sizes.png.

tess: Legal note: avoid dollar claims or SLA absolutes. @marie, can you confirm legal sweep?

marie: Legal only if we state specific savings. Keep phrasing generic. I'll do brand+legal sweep after comps. Also ensure color contrast AA for all text.

brand-bot: Naming reminder: use MIQ_launch2026_{asset}_{channel}_{variant}. Example: MIQ_launch2026_herobench_og_static. Tag frames in Figma with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14 for automated export.

zoe: Accessibility: SVG funnels should be keyboard-focusable and include textual descriptions in <desc>. Alt text example: "Scatter plot showing tradeoff between cost and p95 latency; clusters labeled lower-cost and lower-latency".

miguel: Need the final CSV and copy variants today to hit tomorrow noon. Drop metrics to the drive link and paste here.

tess: Uploading CSV now: https://drive.redwood/marketing/benchmarks/2026-apr-launch.csv (fields: model,cost_per_1000,p95_ms,tokens_sec). Also CTAs: "Try a demo", "Watch the webinar", "Start trial" + APAC short variants: "Demo", "Watch".

miguel: Got it. We'll bin p95 > 2500ms outliers and normalize cost to USD.

zoe: Small ask: provide a 1-column mobile-first thumbnail with copy-first layout and a badge PNG (transparent) for emails.

tess: I'll post landing copy in 20m. Can design drop initial frames by 10:30 PT?

miguel: Yes. Static comps by 10:30 PT, animated cards by Thu EOD, final exports Fri 11:00 PT.

brand-bot: Reminder: tag final Figma pages with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14 and include alt text in Figma component descriptions.

tess: Thanks team. @miguel please ping when first comps are up so we can do the brand/legal sweep. :rocket:
